name: Onamuchi
source: Susanoo's descendant and the true form of Daikoku. Betrayed by his brother and lost everything, Onamuji is fully loyal to Susanoo for guiding and granting him his second chance at life, and was given the title of the World Representative and the name of Okuninushi by Susanoo before Susanoo himself was exiled. Following his own exile at the hand of Amaterasu, the only thing left in the once noble heart of Okuninushi is only revenge against the Sun Goddess who took everything from him.
